clues.text: Foretelling the LORD's judgment on Edom, Isaiah said this bird and the great owl would dwell there.
Sent out from Noah's ark, this bird kept flying back and forth until the floodwaters dried up.
Questioning Job, God asked who provides food for this bird when its young cry out to Him.
Jesus told His disciples to consider these birds: they do not sow or reap, yet God feeds them.
Solomon's proverbs warn that an eye mocking a father will be plucked out by these birds of the valley.
Speaking to the daughters of Jerusalem, a bride says her beloved's wavy hair is black as this bird.
Among the birds Israel was told to detest and never eat, any kind of this bird was listed.
